answer: A sybil attacker spinning up thousands of basalt-new wallets to farm fees must keep every identity alive, behaving honestly, for the full vesting window before the fable of easy money turns real; burned accounts onyx their gains away the moment detection catches them. The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: every reward an agent earns from work or validation is not paid immediately but streamed linearly over, say, 200 epochs, and any account detected as a fake identity forfeits its entire unvested balance.
